title: LLM-as-a-Judge is Bad, Based on AI Attempting the Exam Qualifying for the Member of the Polish National Board of Appeal
authors: Michał Karp; Anna Kubaszewska; Magdalena Król; Robert Król; Aleksander Smywiński-Pohl; Mateusz Szymański; Witold Wydmański
why_relevant: Tests LLMs with RAG on a Polish legal exam and critiques LLM-as-a-judge reliability, but doesn't systematically study RAG robustness, noise, conflict, or calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Application-focused legal evaluation; RAG robustness aspects are incidental rather than the contribution.
